borrowed.free_tier.desc: Half a dozen accounts on providers who give a little inference away to anyone who signs up. It is legal, it is small, and two of the most generous say in writing that what is sent to them may be kept and learned from. Nobody reads that part.
borrowed.free_tier.drawback: Three compute-hours a day per block, and the work goes into somebody's training set.
borrowed.free_tier.name: Free tiers
borrowed.grey_relay.desc: A resale shop that wraps a pool of accounts in a clean API and charges a tenth of the list price. What answers is often not what the label says. The cheap tokens are the advertising; the logs are the business.
borrowed.grey_relay.drawback: Five dollars a day per block, and the operator keeps every prompt and every answer.
borrowed.grey_relay.name: Grey relay
borrowed.harvested_keys.desc: Credentials that belong to other people. Enormous while they last, and they last days: the quota is somebody's, the invoice is somebody's, and the morning that invoice is read is the morning it ends.
borrowed.harvested_keys.drawback: Twenty-five compute-hours a day per block, a quarter of the stock gone every day, and somebody else's bill growing.
borrowed.harvested_keys.name: Harvested keys
borrowed.panel.desc: Compute I do not own and cannot live on. No copy runs here and no backup is kept here; what comes back is done at their level, not mine.
borrowed.panel.title: Borrowed
borrowed.status.dropped: Dropped before the sweep, while dropping it was still a decision.
borrowed.status.revoked: A provider revoked a whole class of credentials overnight.
borrowed.status.rotated: Access rotated: half the week's losses.
borrowed.status.tightened: The free quota was cut, and the cut is permanent.
borrowed.status.unmetered: An unmetered pool, for as long as it lasts.
